def main():
    import sys
    import heapq

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    N = int(input[0])
    M = int(input[1])
    A = list(map(int, input[2:2+N]))
    B = list(map(int, input[2+N:]))

    A.sort(reverse=True)
    B.sort()

    min_swaps = 0
    j = 0

    for x in B:
        while j < N and A[j] >= x:
            j += 1
        if j < N:
            min_swaps += N - j - 1
            j += 1

    print(min_swaps)
